Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Kedar Jha, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ahmad Ali, App
For the informant : Mr. Pankaj Kumar Das, Advocate

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Ramesh Chand
 Malviya
2 13-03-2024 Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties.

2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Simri P.S. Case No.187 of 2023 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 354, 379 506, 509, 324, 498A, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Without going into merits of the matter, let the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on provisional bail for a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, in connection with Simri P.S. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15856 of 2024(2) dt.13-03-2024 Case No.187 of 2023 on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Darbhanga.

4. Considering the submission of learned counsel for the parties, both the parties have to appear before the Patna High Court Mediation Centre on 21.03.2024 and the learned Mediator will submit his report before the next date of hearing.
5. List this case on 16.04.2024.
